patches.title: All Open Surfaces Before Containers
patches.principle: Before opening any closed container, inspect all open surfaces like countertops and tables for the target object.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and open surfaces remain.

patches.title: Transform Then Transport
patches.principle: After picking up the object, go directly to the transformation appliance (e.g., sink) before moving to the destination.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning the object before placement.

patches.title: Open Destination Before Placing
patches.principle: If the destination is a closed container, open it before attempting to place the object inside.
patches.when_to_apply: When placing an object into a closed drawer, cabinet, or similar container.
